items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Marit was a girl I went with. ... She also was instrumental in getting the Norwegian television to hear my music and play it.

ctx.x: That’s when your good sense kicked in. We were talking about Norway. One of other people who is in that dedication, I think right under Bosse – and I may be mispronouncing it – Marit Jerstad?
Marit was a girl I went with.
You called her the heart and soul of Norway in your dedication. That’s very nice.
